theme.rationale: An editorial, premium professional-services aesthetic (advisory firm style) relies on a crisp light theme to prioritize clarity and typography, with specific high-contrast 'Deep Navy' sections (like 'Why ANUYORA') to create pacing and visual interest.

rules: Use Playfair Display for large hero headlines and section titles. Ensure tracking-tight for sizes above 3xl.
Use Manrope for all body copy, forms, and UI elements. Clean grotesque pairing.
Strict avoidance of Inter and Roboto.
Never center-align paragraphs; maintain strong flush-left editorial reading lines.
Maintain a 2-step Tailwind scale gap between H2 and H3/Body.

visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a very subtle noise/grain or the abstract light paper texture as a fixed background overlay (opacity 2-4%) to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.dividers: Extensive use of hairline borders (1px solid border_hairline) to separate sections, list items, and form fields. Avoid drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.corners: Sharp (rounded-none) or extremely subtle (rounded-sm) to maintain an authoritative, established advisory feel.

components.button: Pill-shaped or crisp rectangle, dark navy background, white text, subtle scale on hover. No gradients.
components.inputs: Editorial style: transparent background, solid hairline bottom border, no side/top borders. Label transitions on focus.
components.accordion: Flush-left, hairline divider between items, subtle plus/minus icon.
components.marquee: Slow, organic editorial ribbon. Serif font, large spacing (gap-24), muted text.

layouts.general: Large whitespace. py-24 to py-32 for section padding. Container padding px-6 md:px-12.
layouts.hero: Typography-driven. Massive H1 with line-by-line reveal, flush left. Minimal to no imagery in the hero; let the type breathe.
layouts.grids: Use the 'Bento' or multi-column grid with heavy asymmetry. E.g., 4 columns for Services, heavily utilizing negative space.

motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling is mandatory for the premium feel.
motion.reveals: Masked line-by-line text reveal for main headlines (Framer Motion).
motion.parallax: Subtle Y-axis parallax on section backgrounds or large typographic elements.
motion.interactions: Restrained. No bouncy animations. Use easeOutCubic transitions.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure Playfair Display is thick enough at smaller weights. Maintain APCA standards.
accessibility.aria: Include aria-labels on the marquee and accordion.

media.strategy: Extremely restrained. No stock business people. Only abstract architectural or texture images to establish mood.

image_urls.description: Abstract white paper texture, can be used as a 3-5% opacity overlay on the light theme for an editorial feel.
Minimalist modern office detail. Can be used in the About section or Contact page as a subtle, heavily faded background to denote a professional environment without looking like cheap stock.
Glass divider room. Another option for a very clean, structured professional background.

Home.Hero: Typography-driven, 'Bookkeeping that works like part of your team.'
Home.Services: 'The bookkeeping work that keeps business moving.' with 4 service areas. Asymmetric grid.
Home.Why_ANUYORA: Deep Navy section. 'Your team, extended.' High contrast.
Home.How_It_Works: 5-step 'Simple to start. Built to scale.' Minimal list layout.
Home.Final_CTA: Massive typography 'Let's build the right bookkeeping support...'

pages_structure.Services: 9 services list. Clean text-heavy layout. Bottom section 'Built around the way you work.'
pages_structure.How_We_Work: Hero 'We fit into your workflow...', 5 steps, 'Need dedicated capacity?', FAQ with 6 questions.
pages_structure.About: 'A focused approach to finance outsourcing.' Statement text.
pages_structure.Contact: Editorial form. Inputs as just bottom-borders. Radio buttons for 'I am a' and multi-select. Notice about sensitive info.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, lenis (or @studio-freight/react-lenis), lucide-react, react-fast-marquee, clsx, tailwind-merge.
Configure Tailwind with the custom fonts (Playfair Display, Manrope) and colors (navy, off-white).
Create a fixed sticky header with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md, solid bottom hairline) containing the wordmark logo and navigation. DO NOT use complete transparent background.
Build a custom editorial form component for the Contact page without using standard boxed inputs. Use bottom borders.
Use Framer Motion to create the line-by-line text reveal for the H1s.
Ensure the 'Why ANUYORA' section is wrapped in the deep navy color with light text to break up the page pacing.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and negative space.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states separate good from extraordinary.
Implement `data-testid` on all interactive and key informational elements.
